header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's tmp1231.tmp1231.opp-lat1, from Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. The whole work is translated. It was chosen because no English translation of it could be found.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation of the whole work, checked against the original by a second AI only in samples. No specialist has reviewed it.

notes.urn:cts:latinLit:tmp1231.tmp1231.opp-lat: Most personal names in this list are given in a nominative inferred from corrupt or unusual genitives; many are unidentified or garbled forms (e.g. Syridonus, Qoiotus, Mosceneus, Gemmeous, Thrugenis, Racsus, Absaloius) and should be checked against the Latin. Natale is rendered 'Feast' (the saint's heavenly birthday), though on 28 January it is qualified by 'de nativitate'. Scanning or numeral errors corrected: 'tdus' to Idus; 'II Kal.' to IX at 21 February and 24 March, as the sequence requires; April's 'XII' days to XXX; 'esus' to Jesus; 'InSyna' to in Syria; 'Domlhi, Acacf, Palatim' read as Domnini, Acaci, Palatini (Domini is possible but unlikely). The printed text has no entry for 19 January or 26 January. 15 Jan.: 'Antiochia' is as printed. 17 Jan.: the Twins of Langres are usually Speusippus, Eleusippus and Meleusippus, with Leonilla, Jonilla and Neon, so the list here seems garbled; 'Deasci' is taken as Die, tentatively. 18 Jan.: 'Prisci' may stand for Saint Prisca. 24 Jan.: 'Par., et aliorum' is unclear and left as printed; 'Par.' may be an abbreviation or a variant marker. 5 Feb. wording 'Gelasii Magni' could be two names; 'Filiae' may stand for Phileas. 8 Feb. 'In India civitate' is odd ('in the city of India'). Places not identified: Suevum on Cyprus, Iulia, Niora, Sitia (possibly Scythia). 7 March: Sischam, which the edition suggests is Scythia, may rather be a corruption of Fécamp (Fiscamnum), since Hildemarca was abbess there. 21 Jan.: 'Arvernis' could mean Clermont. 'Parum' on 1 April is uncertain.

Many names in this list are garbled and cannot be securely identified; unusual forms are simply Anglicised from the printed spelling. 15 Kal. Maii (ref .105): 'Dei Acluperti' is unintelligible and kept as printed. Ref .108, .176: 'Salonica' may mean Thessalonica or Salona. Ref .108: 'Anthi' may stand for Anthia, Eleutherius' mother. Ref .115: 'sic celebrantur in letania majori' is obscure; the subject is unstated, and the Greater Litany falls on this day (25 April). Ref .118: 'Euseppi' read as Eusebii. Ref .125: 'Nectarientui' read as Nectarii; the word may conceal more. Ref .127: 'Augustitil' read as Augustini; Augusti is also possible. Ref .130: 'Bbitati' is corrupt. Ref .133: 'Saturnini Marcelli' could be one person. Ref .139: 'Eunucorum' may be a corrupt name rather than 'the eunuchs'. Ref .140: 'Sesalft' is corrupt; 'Nostata' may conceal Ostia, and 'Aurae' Aurea. Ref .143: a female bishop 'Passelia' suggests a corrupt name or title. Ref .151: 'Ganti, Gantiani' read as Canti, Cantiani. Ref .154: 'UI' read as III. Ref .159: 'Nahor' read as Nabor. Ref .161: the edition marks a gap. Ref .163: 'Tribolis Madaledis' is unclear and may be two names, or a name with the place Tripoli. Ref .167: 'Caulaurea' is unidentified. Ref .173: 'Nota' read as Nola. Ref .174: 'A Viii' read tentatively as Aviti. Ref .176: 'Aceiabae regis' is unidentified. Ref .182: 'episcopi' may apply to both Augustine and Leo.

Many of the names in these lists are garbled forms; where no known saint could be identified, they are given as the text has them. 'Munngundae' is read as Monegund of Tours. VI Ides of July: seven brothers are announced but only six named. V Ides of July: 'Bassenae abbatis' is rendered as written; the sex of the person and the identification are uncertain, and an abbess may be meant. Eve of the Ides of July: 'Aniici' is uncertain; Anicius is a conjecture. XV Kalends of August: 'Symphorisi patris' is rendered as written, though tradition makes Symphorosa the mother of seven brothers; the line also includes the entry for XIV Kalends. X Kalends of August: 'Bimitivae' is read as Primitiva. VII Kalends of August: 'sanctorum Adriani' is awkward, since a plural is followed by a single name; it is rendered 'the saints Adrian and others'. III Nones of August: 'protomartyris' is presumably Stephen, whose name has dropped out, and the following Euphrosinus may be a separate entry. Nones of August: the first Augusta is presumably Augsburg (Afra); the second may be Autun (Augustodunum), Cassian's see. VII Ides of August: 'Donti' may be Donatus. Lost text marked '....' in the edition is given as [...].

nodes.text: OLD GALLICAN MARTYROLOGY, FROM THE MANUSCRIPT OF THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS LORD CHAUVELIN, KEEPER OF THE ROYAL SEALS.
(Martène, Amplissima collectio, vol. VI.)
HERE BEGINS THE MARTYROLOGY.
JANUARY.
January has 31 days, the moon 30.
Kalends of January: the Circumcision of our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh.
In the East, Stephen. At Nicomedia, Bishop Euphrosinus, Primianus.
4th before the Nones of January: at Antioch, Bishop Syridonus, Firmus, Abbot Macarius. These in Ethiopia: Rutulus, Claudia, Aurigo, Vetalis, Yertia, Stephen.
3rd before the Nones of January: Cyricus, Primus. In the city of Paris, the Deposition [burial] of Saint Genevieve, virgin. In the city of Vienne, the blessed Bishop Florentius.
Day before the Nones of January: in Africa, Aquilinus, Geminus, Qoiotus. In the East, at Bononia, Ermes, Aggeus and Gaius.
Nones of January: at Jerusalem, the Deposition of Simeon the prophet.

8th before the Ides of January: the Epiphany of our Lord Jesus Christ; Peter and Mark. In the city of Rennes, the birth, the ordination to the episcopate and the Deposition of Saint Melanius, bishop, celebrated there.
7th before the Ides of January: at Nicomedia, Lucian the priest, Felix, Januarius, Poliarcus, Filoro.
6th before the Ides of January: in Greece, Timothy, Jocundus. In the city of Autun, the Deposition of Bishop Egimonius; Peter, Lucius.
5th before the Ides of January: in Africa, Epictatus, Jocondus, Quintus, Secundus, Saturninus, Felix, Fortunatus, Vitalis, Martial.
4th before the Ides of January: the Deposition of Bishop Melchiades. In Africa, Revocatus, Firmus, Saturus.
3rd before the Ides of January: at Alexandria, Peter, Siverus, Eliucus. Day before the Ides of January: in Achaia, Cyriacus, Mosceneus, Saturus.
Ides of January: at Rome, Secunda, Zorona and 41 soldiers. At Poitiers, the Deposition of Saint Hilary, confessor.
19th before the Kalends of February: at Nola in Campania, the Passion of Saint Felix; Paul, Succisus, Victurinus.
18th before the Kalends of February: at Antioch, the Deposition of Habakkuk the prophet. In the city of Reims, the Deposition of Saint Remigius, bishop and confessor.
17th before the Kalends of February: at Rome, the Deposition of Saint Marcellus, bishop and confessor. At Arles, the Deposition of Saint Honoratus, bishop.

16th before the Kalends of February: in the Thebaid, the Deposition of Saint Anthony the monk. In the city of Bourges, Saint Sulpicius, bishop. At Langres, the Passion of the holy Twins Speusippus, Leonellus, Junella, Neo; and in the city of Die, the Deposition of Bishop Marcellus.

15th before the Kalends of February: at Rome, the Dedication of the chair of Saint Peter the apostle, who first sat at Rome. At Rome, Saints Priscus, Tyrsus and Gallinicus. At Tours, in the monastery of Marmoutier, the Deposition of Saint Leobardus, confessor.
13th before the Kalends of February: at Rome, Saints Sebastian and Fabian, martyrs. At Lyon, Clement the priest.
12th before the Kalends of February: at Rome, Saint Agnes, virgin. Among the Arverni, the Deposition of Saint Avitus, bishop; Projectus, Amerinus, Saturninus.
11th before the Kalends of February: in the Spains, Bishop Valerius and Vincent the deacon and 18 martyrs, with their companions.
10th before the Kalends of February: in Mauretania, the Passion of Severian and Aquila and his wife; Eugenius and Macarius, Donatus.
9th before the Kalends of February: at Antioch, the Passion of Saint Babylas, with three [others]. Par., and of others. Eugenius, Felicissimus, Saturninus.
8th before the Kalends of February: Antmasius, Sabinus, Leodotius, Thrugenis. At Rome, the Translation of Saint Paul the apostle.
6th before the Kalends of February: in Apollonia, Gaius, Celestus, Donativus, Publius.
5th before the Kalends of February: at Rome, the Feast of Saint Agnes, virgin, of [her] birth; David, Julian.
4th before the Kalends of February: in Tuscia, Constantius, Bishop Hippolytus. At Trier, the Deposition of Bishop Valerius.
3rd before the Kalends of February: in Africa, Belleanus, Cierus, Philippianus and 124 others.
Day before the Kalends of February: at Alexandria, Ammonius, Cyriacus, Gemmeous, Zelasius.
FEBRUARY.
February has 28 days, the moon 29.
Kalends of February: at Ravenna, Bishop Severus, Victor, and the Passion of Saints Vindimialis and Singenius.
4th before the Nones of February: the Purification of the blessed Mary, when Jesus was presented in the temple. Marinus, Victor.
3rd before the Nones of February: in Africa, Felix. At Gap, the Deposition of the holy bishops Ferridus and Remedius. At Lyon, Bishop Lupicinus.
Day before the Nones of February: at Forum Sempronii, the Feast of Geminus, Gelasius Magnus, Donatus, Timous, Bishop Filia with his daughter.
Nones of February: in Sicily, at Catania, the Passion of Saint Agatha, martyr. At Vienne, the Deposition of Bishop Avitus.
8th before the Ides of February: in Achaia, Saturninus, Revocata. At Caesarea in Cappadocia, the Passion of Saint Dorotheus and Theophilus.
7th before the Ides of February: among the Britons, the Feast of Bishop Agulus; Anatolius, Amon.
6th before the Ides of February: in the city of India, the Passion of Saint Thomas the apostle. In Lesser Armenia, the Feast of Dionysius, Onelianus, Lucius. The Deposition of Bishop Paul.
5th before the Ides of February: at Suevum on Cyprus, the Feast of Alexander, Paul, Dionysius. The Deposition of Praejectus.
4th before the Ides of February: at Rome, Saint Soteris, virgin. In the city of Saintes, Saint Trojanus, bishop, and Baldecundis, abbess.
3rd before the Ides of February: in Apulia, Poenis, Seufraxus. In Campania, Basilian.
Day before the Ides of February: in Africa, Damian; in Iulia, Donatus, Heraclius, Vincent, Susanna.
Ides of February: at Nicomedia, the Passion of Julian, Tullianus. At Lyon, the Deposition of the blessed Bishop Stephen.
16th before the Kalends of March: at Rome, the Passion of Valentine, martyr; Felicola. In Tuscia, in the city of Spoleto, Vitalis, Cyrion, Martianus.
15th before the Kalends of March: at Antioch, Josippus the deacon, Apollonius, Romanus and Saint Agape, virgin.
14th before the Kalends of March: in the Britains, Faustinus, Viventia. In Egypt, Julian, with Egyptians numbering 5,000.
13th before the Kalends of March: in Africa, Concordia, Donatus, Castus, Secundian.
12th before the Kalends of March: in Africa, Rutulus, Silvanus, Darsicus, Secundinus. The Deposition of Abbot Benedict.
11th before the Kalends of March: in Africa, Publius, Julian, Marcellus, Majulius, Julius.
10th before the Kalends of March: at Rome, the Deposition of Bishop Gaius; Victor, Corona, Didymus.
9th before the Kalends of March: in Africa, Verolus, Secundinus, Servulus, Jucundus.
8th before the Kalends of March: the Chair of Saint Peter at Antioch. At Rome, the Feast of Saint Concordia; Thecla, virgin, disciple of Saint Paul the apostle; Valerius, Gago.
7th before the Kalends of March: in the Pannonias, Senerotus, Antigonus, Rutulus. In Asia, Cosanus.
6th before the Kalends of March: at Caesarea, Herolus, Lucius, Surius, Felix. At Nicomedia, Lucian the priest.
5th before the Kalends of March: in Africa, Donatus, Justus, Aurilus. In Pamphylia, the Feast of Saint Nestor and Castus.
4th before the Kalends of March: the Feast of Saints Alexander, Nestor, Epicinus, Justus.
3rd before the Kalends of March: at Thessalonica, Alexander, Thicianus, Gayanus.
Day before the Kalends of March: the Feast of Saints Celer, Pupillus, Justiopulus.
MARCH.
March has 31 days, the moon 30.
Kalends of March: the Feast of Saint Leo, Donatus, Abundantius, Adrian, Victor.
6th before the Nones of March: George, Herolus, Absaloius. At Caesarea, Bishop Lucius, Primitivus, Januarius.
5th before the Nones of March: Felix, Luciolus, Justus, Fortunatus, Marcia.
4th before the Nones of March: Bishop Lucius, Roligagus, Palatinus, Oranus, Sabellinus, Paul, Gregory.
3rd before the Nones of March: in Africa, Adrian, Evolus, Eusebius. At Antioch, the Passion of Saint Phocas; Saturninus.
Day before the Nones of March: at Nicomedia, Victor, Victurinus, Pabia, Diodorus, Claudian.
Nones of March: in Africa, Saturus, Revocatus, Jocundus. In Mauretania, the Passion of Saints Perpetua and Felicity. In Sischa [perhaps, in Scythia], the Deposition of Hildomarca, virgin.
8th before the Ides of March: at Nicomedia, Bishop Quirillus and Cavitulinus, Rogatus, Felix.
7th before the Ides of March: Julian, Sicus, Cyril. Marianus, Rogatus, Concessus.
6th before the Ides of March: in Niora, Gorgonius, Palatinus, Firmus. At Antioch, Agapha, virgin, and Mariana.
5th before the Ides of March: at Carthage, Heraclius, Zosimus, Bishop Philomus, Candidus.
4th before the Ides of March: at Rome, the Deposition of Pope Gregory of blessed memory; Bishop Innocent, Bishop Racsus.
3rd before the Ides of March: at Nicomedia, Matidonus the priest, Bishop Julius, Plonus, Victurinus.
Day before the Ides of March: at Nicomedia, Felicissimus, Dativus, Peter, Frunimus.
Ides of March: at Nicomedia, Lucius, bishop and martyr, Faustus, Silvius, Luke the evangelist, Saints Longinus, Paul, Trupolus, Octavius. At Nicomedia, the Deposition of Saint Eufaxia.
17th before the Kalends of April: at Aquileia, Hilaritas, Jaous, Datian, Papinus.
16th before the Kalends of April: at Nicomedia, Dionysius, Januarius, Nonna. At Rome, Bishop Alexander, Theodulus the deacon.
15th before the Kalends of April: at Alexandria, Collegus the deacon, Colodius the deacon, Quintus, Rogatus.
14th before the Kalends of April: at Caesarea in Cappadocia, Theodore the priest, Lucellus, Bishop Theodore, Bishop Leontius.
13th before the Kalends of April: at Antioch, Manetus, Joseph. In Syria, Paul, Valentine. In the monastery of Fontenelle in Gaul, Bishop Wulfram.
12th before the Kalends of April: at Alexandria, Seraphion, Josippus, Volusian, Ammonius, Polycarp.
11th before the Kalends of April: in the city of Narbonne, the Feast of Paul the confessor; Saturninus, Decronus, Arion.
10th before the Kalends of April: the Feast of Saints Fidelis, Theodore the priest, Paul, Caesaria, Julian, Dionysius.
9th before the Kalends of April: in Syrian Seleucia, Agapitus, Romulus, Rogatus, Victorinus, Saturninus.
8th before the Kalends of April: the Annunciation to Saint Mary by the angel. Our Lord Jesus Christ was crucified, and the Feast of Castulus, Erostratus.
7th before the Kalends of April: the Feast of Saint Castulus, Munatus the priest, Bishop Peter, Bishop Cassian.
6th before the Kalends of April: at Jerusalem, the Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the Feast of Saints Romulus, Acutus.
5th before the Kalends of April: at Caesarea, Rogatus, Alexander. In the city of Chalon, the Deposition of King Guntram.
4th before the Kalends of April: at Nicomedia, Pastor, Victorinus, Saturninus, Theodore the priest, Pentalus.
3rd before the Kalends of April: the Feast of Domninus, Acacius, Palatinus. In the city of Orléans, the Deposition of Pastor.
Day before the Kalends of April: the Feast of Saints Anetus, Felix, Valeria.
APRIL.
April has 30 days, the moon 29.
Kalends of April: in Armenia, Parus, Quintian, Victor, Secundus, Dionysius.
4th before the Nones of April: in Africa, Saints Ampianus, Victor, Marcellinus. In the city of Lyon, the Deposition of Nicetius.
3rd before the Nones of April: in Sitia, Saints Thomas, Evagrius, Benignus, Theodosia, Donatus.
Day before the Nones of April: Agatomus the deacon, Paul, Matutinus, Urban, Saturninus.
Nones of April: in Nicomedia, Saint Claudian, Firmus, Biremus the bishop.
8th before the Ides of April: Quiriacus, Epiphanius the bishop, also Donatus, Sixtus, Rufinus.
7th before the Ides of April: in Antioch of Syria, Timothy, Diogenes, Macaria, Maxima, Pululus.
6th before the Ides of April: Feast of Thimorus, Macarius, Connexus, Maxima, Concessus.
5th before the Ides of April: Feast of Demetrius the deacon, Hilary, Concessus, Fortunatus.
4th before the Ides of April: Feast of Apollonius the priest, Hilary, Donatus, Gaianus, Theodore the priest.
3rd before the Ides of April: in Mauretania, Feast of Saints Salo, Maxima, Domninus the bishop, Eustorgius the priest.
Day before the Ides of April: at Pergamum, Feast of Saints Carpus the bishop, Paul, Isaac; at Rome, Julius the bishop, Agapius, Valerius, Publius, Bassus.
Ides of April: at Chalcedon, Feast of Saints Eufiona, Polycarp the bishop, Paul the deacon.
18th before the Kalends of May: at Rome, Tiburtius, Valerian, Maximus, Quiriacus, Optatus, Marcia.
17th before the Kalends of May: Feast of Marro, Messor, Mositus, Veronica and Victa, Diogenes, *Dei Acluperti*, Apodomius with two brothers.
16th before the Kalends of May: in Achaea, Feast of Saints Callistus, Carisus, Martial, Silvinus.
15th before the Kalends of May: in Nicaea, Peter the deacon, Hermogenes, Donatus, Fortunatus, Martian.
14th before the Kalends of May: in the city of Salonica, Septimus the deacon, Victuricus. At Rome, Eleutherius the bishop and Anthus.
13th before the Kalends of May: Feast of Saints Hermogenes, Gaius, Rufus, Elvius, Serician, Vincent.
12th before the Kalends of May: at Rome, Deposition of Victor the bishop, Salvian, Jaracus, Donatus. In the city of Auxerre, Martin the priest.
11th before the Kalends of May: Feast of Fortunatus, Arator the priest, Vitalis, Apruncius the bishop.
10th before the Kalends of May: at Rome, Deposition of Pope Gaius, Primulus, Turdian. At Lyon, Saint Epipodius. At Sens, Leo the bishop.
9th before the Kalends of May: in the city of Valence, Felix the priest, Fortunatus the deacon, Achilleus the deacon and Pantaleon.
8th before the Kalends of May: in Alexandria, Corona the virgin. And on this day, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. In the city of Lyon, Alexander with 33 others.
7th before the Kalends of May: in Persia, in the city of Diospolis, Passion of Saint George. At Lyon, Rusticus the bishop. At Rome, they are celebrated thus in the Greater Litany.
6th before the Kalends of May: Feast of Aurelius, Leonides, Vindeus, Maximus, Martiana, Gemelinus.
5th before the Kalends of May: Feast of Saints Castor, Andimus the bishop, Stephen the bishop, Antoninus the priest.
4th before the Kalends of May: at Rome, Saint Vitalis. In Pannonia, Eusebius the bishop and Alipius, Lucian, Nicaea the virgin, and the Deposition of Amalfred, bishop and confessor.
3rd before the Kalends of May: in Alexandria, Germanus the priest, Prosdocius the deacon, Prudentius, Urban.

Day before the Kalends of May: Feast of Saints Dorotheus the priest, Rodocian the deacon. At Rome, Quirinus the bishop, Tyrentus, Marinus the priest, Saturninus, Aemilian, Majorica, Polycronius the bishop.
MAY.
May has 31 days, the moon 30.
Kalends of May: Beginning of the preaching of our Lord Jesus Christ, and [feast] of Saints Philip the apostle, Orientius the bishop, Amator the bishop, Sigismund, king and martyr.
6th before the Nones of May: Feast of Saints Germanus, Caelestina, Felix, Caelestinus, Chetinus, Hermogenia.
5th before the Nones of May: at Jerusalem, Finding of the Holy Cross. At Rome, Saints Juvenal, Alexander and Eventius, and Avitus the deacon.
4th before the Nones of May: at Nicomedia, Antony, Caelestinus, Fortonus the priest, Peter.
3rd before the Nones of May: in Africa, Gregory, Felicissimus, Hilary the bishop. At Vienne, Nectarius the bishop, Saint Amator.
Day before the Nones of May: Feast of Saint Gerontius the confessor. In the city of Milan, Victor and Felix. At Auxerre, Saints Valerius the bishop, Maximus.
Nones of May: in Nicomedia, Flavius the bishop, Augustine the bishop, and the three brothers Marcellinus, Macrobius, Eutychius.
8th before the Ides of May: at Milan, Victor, Eticus, Saturninus. In the Saintonge, Saint Martin. At Auxerre, Saint Palladius the bishop.
7th before the Ides of May: Feast of Querilla, Quindeus, Zeno, Aphrodisius, Timothy, Primolus, Beatus the confessor, Gordian.
6th before the Ides of May: at Rome, Saints Gordian, *Bbitatus*, and elsewhere Sovenantus, Job the prophet.
5th before the Ides of May: in Sirmium, Feast of Saints Montanus, Septimus. At Vienne, Deposition of the bishops Mamertus and Martin.
4th before the Ides of May: at Rome, Feast of Saints Pancras, Nereus and Achilleus.
3rd before the Ides of May: in Palestine, Taracus the bishop and Andronicus. In Pollentia, Victor; Saturninus, Marcellus the bishop.
2nd before the Ides of May: Feast of Saints Victor the soldier, and Corona, Secundian, Quartus.
Ides of May: at Portus Romanus, Prestabilis, Felix, Victor, Peter and Andrew, Paul and Dionysius. Deposition of Benedict the confessor.
17th before the Kalends of June: in Isauria, Aquilinus, Victorian, Heraclius, Paulinus, Fadolus the priest.
16th before the Kalends of June: at Rome, Partinus, Gallus, Chorus, Heraclius, Paul, Aquilinus, Victor.
15th before the Kalends of June: Feast of Potamo the priest, Orthasius the priest, Luciosus, Gasus and Victor.
14th before the Kalends of June: at Rome, Feast of Potentian, Gallicierus, Paternus, the eunuchs Quinquus, Primolus, Sallust, Fortunatus.
13th before the Kalends of June: Feast of Saints Marcellus, *Sesalft*. At Rome, Basilla. In Nostata, Aura.
12th before the Kalends of June: in Mauretania, Timothy, Pehetus, Victor, Donatus. At Cahors, Deposition of Saint Desiderius.
11th before the Kalends of June: at Rome, Faustinus, Venustus, Cassius, Aemelunus. In Corsica, Saint Julia.
10th before the Kalends of June: in the Spains, Saints Epictetus, Aptonius, Desiderius the bishop, Passelia the bishop.
9th before the Kalends of June: in Istria, Zebellus, Servulus. In the city of Nantes, Rogatian, Donatian.
8th before the Kalends of June: in Tuscia, in the city of Lera, Saint Sententiatus. On the Via Nomentana, Saint Urban the bishop, Poletratus.
7th before the Kalends of June: Feast of Herealus, Paul, Rufinus and Valerius, Saturus, Viturus, and the Passion of Saint Priscus the martyr.
6th before the Kalends of June: Feast of Aquillus the priest, Evangelus, Elias, Lucian, Quintus, Estiabilus.
5th before the Kalends of June: in Pamphylia, Zetolus, Primolus. In the city of Paris, Deposition of Saint Germanus.
4th before the Kalends of June: Feast of Pollio, Crispolus, Primus. In the city of Trier, Maximinus the bishop, where many wonders are done.
3rd before the Kalends of June: at Antioch, Saints Sicus, Palatinus, Gabinus, Crispolus.
Day before the Kalends of June: at Rome, Saint Petronilla the virgin, daughter of Saint Peter, Cantius, Cantian, Protus, Praevilanus, Chrysogonus, Cantianilla.
JUNE.
June has 30 days, the moon 29.
Kalends of June: in Thessalonica, Octavus, Crispin, Juventius, Castulus, Arapus, Publius with 126 others. At Vibina, Gladus the bishop.
4th before the Nones of June: at Rome, Marcellinus and Peter. Also Marcellinus the bishop, Zechariah the priest, Rogatian the bishop with 48 others.
3rd before the Nones of June: in Africa, Quirinus, Abidian, Neptorus, Juliana the virgin. In the city of Orléans, Lifard the priest.
Day before the Nones of June: Feast of Camasia, Julius, Saturninus. In Italy, Rusticus the bishop, Dacian.
Nones of June: in Egypt, Martian, Nigrandus and Apollonia, Gregory.
8th before the Ides of June: at Noviodunum, Amantius, Lucius, Alexander, Claudius the bishop, Ceratus the bishop.
7th before the Ides of June: Feast of Paul, Fortunatus, Magrus, Primosus, Lucian.
6th before the Ides of June: at Rome, Primus and Felix, Nabor, Nazarius. In the city of Soissons, Deposition of Saint Medard, confessor and pontiff.
5th before the Ides of June: Feast of Maximinus the priest, Vincent, Basilides. Zechariah, Censurius the bishop, and the Deposition of Sagittarius the confessor.
4th before the Ides of June: Saints Basilla, Crispolus [...] Aurisus, Rogatus.
3rd before the Ides of June: Feast of Emeritus, Victurian, Victor and Fortunatus.
Day before the Ides of June: Feast of Saints Basilides, Nabor and Felix, Tribolis, Madaledis.
Ides of June: in Africa, Lucian, Fortunatus. At Rome, Saint Felicula.

18th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Antony, Quintian, Protus. In the city of Soissons, Valerius and Rufinus, martyrs. In the city of Orléans, Translation of the body of Saint Anianus, confessor and bishop, and the liberation of that city from the Huns.
17th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Saints Hysitus, Clement, Cantian, Jovonian, Philip, Jovian, Candidus, Cantian, Chrysogonus, Quintian.
16th before the Kalends of July: at Caulaurea, Saints Vitus the martyr, Modestus and Crescentius, Cyricus, Julitta his mother.
15th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Saints Alexander, Dioscorus and Marinus, martyrs; Quiriacus, Cyria. In the city of Orléans, Avitus the priest.
14th before the Kalends of July: at Rome, Feast of Mark and Marcellian. At Ravenna, Martorus, Felix, Emelus, Crispin.
13th before the Kalends of July: in Milan, Saints Gervase and Protase, and Celsus the boy. At Rome, Hippolytus, Honoria, Votus, Peter.
12th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Paul, Cyriacus, Felician, Vitalis, Crispin. Deposition of Childemarca, consecrated virgin.
11th before the Kalends of July: in Caesarea, Deposition of Saint Eusebius the bishop, and elsewhere Quiriacus, Apollinaris, Rufinus and Martius.
10th before the Kalends of July: in the Britains, Alban the martyr, with 887 others. At Nola, Paulinus the bishop, and Saint Nicetius the bishop.
9th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Avitus, Aritio, Emeritus, Capitio.
8th before the Kalends of July: in the province of Palestine, Nativity of Saint John the Baptist; and in Ephesus, the assumption of Saint John the apostle.
7th before the Kalends of July: Feast of Saints Lantalibus, Carita. At Salonica, Luca the virgin, and King Aceiaba.
6th before the Kalends of July: at Rome, John and Paul, brothers, and elsewhere Gaudertus, Felix.
5th before the Kalends of July: at Rome, Crispus, Crispinian. Felix, Julian, Primitivus, Justin.
4th before the Kalends of July: in Africa, Fabian, Venustus, Coruccus, Apollonius, Dionysius, Hynosus.
3rd before the Kalends of July: at Rome, Feast of the apostles Peter and Paul and of 976 others.

Day before the Kalends of July: at Limoges, Deposition of Saint Martial the bishop. In the city of Angers, Deposition of Saint Albinus, bishop and confessor; and elsewhere of other saints, Cursicus the priest, Leo the subdeacon.
JULY.
July has 31 days.
Kalends of July: at Rome, Gaius the priest. On Mount Hor, Deposition of Aaron the priest. Augustine, Leo the bishop. In Gaul, Carilefus the confessor.
VI Nones of July: at Rome, Processus and Martinian, and Pope Melchiades. At Tours, Monegund, handmaid of God.
V Nones of July: in Alexandria, Tryphon, Cyro, Apricus, Julian.

IV Nones of July: in Gaul, at Tours, the Ordination to the episcopate, and the Translation of the body, and the Dedication of the basilica of Saint Martin the bishop. At Bourges, Feast of Saint Laurian the martyr.
III Nones of July: Feast of Agatho, Tryphon, Magrinus, Theodotus, Meronus, Rodosia.
Eve of the Nones of July: Feast of Palladius, Philip, Severus, and Zoticus, Arieth.
Nones of July: Feast of Heraclius, Apollonius, Publius with 18 others. At Parma, Novus and Parminus.
VIII Ides of July: Feast of the saints Sustratus, Hesperus, Heraclius, Quantus, Pancras, Cornelian, with others, 60 in number.
VII Ides of July: Feast of the saints Motthus, Faustian, Nathous [...] Felician with 7 priests, and Fraternus the bishop.
VI Ides of July: Feast of the 7 brothers, that is, Felix, Philip, Maximus, Silvanus, Praetextatus, Januarius, with their companions.
V Ides of July: Feast of the saints Marian, Stephen, Leo, Maurice. At Poitiers, Deposition of Bassena the abbot.
IV Ides of July: at Milan, Nabor and Felix, Primitivus. At Lyon, Viventiolus the bishop.
III Ides of July: Feast of Serapion, Attalus, Profilus, Meneus the priest, Trophina the virgin.

Eve of the Ides of July: Feast of the saints Donatus, Antiochus, Marius. At Lyon in Gaul, Justus the bishop, Anicius, bishop and confessor. At Fécamp, Dedication of the basilica of the Most Holy Trinity.
Ides of July: at Portus Romanus, Feast of the saints Zotimus, Bonosus and their companions, Catholinus the deacon.
XVII Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Hilarinus, Macarius, Dionysius.
XVI Kalends of August: Feast of Aquilinus, Biturus, Generosus, Nazarius. At Auxerre, Theodosius the bishop.

XV Kalends of August: at Rome, Feast of Symphorisus, father of the 7 brothers, and elsewhere Flaba the bishop. XIV Kalends of August: Feast of Sisinnius, Lampadius, Peter, Justus, Rusticus the priest.
XIII Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Sabinus, Lucian, Victor, Paul, Romanus, Valerian.
XII Kalends of August: at Rome, Saint Praxedes. At Marseille, Feast of the saints Victor, Alexander, Felician, Adrian.
XI Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Cyril, Andrew, Tabellus, Aurus, Plato.
X Kalends of August: at Rome, Feast of the saints Vincent [...] Apollinaris, Primitiva.
IX Kalends of August: Feast of Saint Victurinus the soldier [...] and of Saint Christina the virgin.
VIII Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Hyacinth, Nonnus, James, Clement and Julian; and in [...] Passion of Saint Christopher the martyr.
VII Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Jovinian, Marcian [...] In Nicomedia, Passion of the saints Adrian and others, 23 in number.
VI Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Julia, Jocunda, Januarius, Simeon, and of Saint Eucherius the bishop.
V Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Theophilus, Auxentius, Prudotus. At Nicomedia, Saint Pantaleon.
IV Kalends of August: Feast of the saints Rufus, Pontian. At Troyes, the saints Lupus, Anastasia. In the city of Orléans, Prosper the bishop.
III Kalends of August: at Rome, Felix, Faustus, Viatrix. At Auxerre, Deposition of the blessed Ursus the bishop.
Eve of the Kalends of August: in Africa, Secundus, Thyrsus [...] At Auxerre, Deposition of Saint Germanus, bishop and confessor.
AUGUST.
August has 31 days.
Kalends of August: at Antioch, Passion of the holy Maccabees with their mother. In the city of Vercelli, in Italy, Saint Eusebius the bishop. In the Spanish provinces, Saint Felix.
IV Nones of August: at Rome, Saint Stephen the pontiff. In Italy, in the city of Verona, Feast of Saint Felix.
III Nones of August: Feast of Metropolus the bishop, Hermelus the martyr, Drogenes. At Jerusalem, Finding of the most blessed protomartyr, Euphrosinus the bishop.
Eve of the Nones of August: Crescentian, Justus [...] Bartholomew.
Nones of August: Feast of Hierenus, Assieradus. In the city of Augusta, Saint Afra. At Augusta, Cassian the bishop. At Châlons, Saint Memmius.
VIII Ides of August: at Rome, Sixtus, Felicissimus and Agapitus, Donatian, Faustinus, and the Passion of Saint Afra.
VII Ides of August: Feast of the saints Effronus, Veneria, Dontus the bishop, Ausentius, Faustinus, Quiriacus, Donatus.
VI Ides of August: Feast of the saints Severian, Victurinus, Albinus, Cyriac, Largus, Metreta the virgin, Gloenes.
V Ides of August: in the East, the saints Firmus, Rusticus, Pinonus, Dionysius. At Limoges, Saint Martin of Brive.
IV Ides of August: Passion of Saint Lawrence the archdeacon, Felicissimus, Crescentio, Januarius.
III Ides of August: Feast of Valerian, Tiburtius and Cecilia the virgin, and Passion of Saint Cassian.
Eve of the Ides of August: Feast of the saints Euplus, Macarius, Julian, Chrysanthus and Daria.
Ides of August: at Rome, Hippolytus the martyr, Pontian. In the city of Poitiers, Deposition of Saint Radegund the queen.
XIX Kalends of September: Feast of [...] Fortunatus, Demetrius, Vincentia, Tatulus.
XVIII Kalends of September: Assumption of Holy Mary, mother of the Lord, Stroctio, Philip, Eutianus.
XVII Kalends of September: Feast of the saints Horionus, Henelia, Agnatus.
